education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science

projects.name: ReVIEW
projects.summary: Built AI-assisted video analysis in a reVISit fork to help researchers review study recordings.
projects.portfolioSummary: I built tools for reviewing research recordings in a reVISit fork, including video analysis, searchable clips, and timelines.
outcomes: Implemented multimodal analysis pipelines combining video, audio, OCR, and language-model outputs.
Added event timelines, clip tagging, semantic search, and cross-recording summaries.

projects.name: Exercise Form Classification System
projects.summary: Collaborated on exercise-video classification and form assessment using pose estimation and neural networks.
projects.portfolioSummary: I worked with a team on models that identify exercises and assess form from video. My code contributions included pose extraction, training, and model experiments.
outcomes: Contributed labeling, YOLO pose extraction, training pipelines, and exploratory data analysis.
Worked on Skeleton CNN and ST-GCN experiments using the Qualcomm exercise-video dataset.

projects.name: Hospital Kiosk
projects.summary: Worked on an agile team building a hospital kiosk application for a software engineering course.
projects.portfolioSummary: I was a back-end developer on a team building a hospital kiosk for a software engineering course. The app included indoor navigation, service requests, and tools for managing hospital data.
outcomes: Contributed back-end development as part of an agile/Scrum team.
Collaborated on an application covering indoor navigation, service requests, and map and employee data.

projects.name: Reimagining Digital Education at Sri Sangwan School
projects.summary: Researched barriers to computer-based learning with a team at Sri Sangwan School.
projects.portfolioSummary: I worked with a WPI and Chulalongkorn team to understand how students at Sri Sangwan School use computers for learning. I helped write the research methods and findings, and edited and revised the full report.
outcomes: Co-authored methodology for understanding students' challenges and authored the corresponding findings section.
Edited and revised the full project report across all sections, alongside contributions to inclusive-education research and analysis of assistive-device costs.
